outcome: decline in hemoglobin levels of >=3 g/dL
cohort: 1071 pregnant women undergoing cesarean sections at a tertiary healthcare center from January 2021 to December 2022, divided into normal platelet (n=636) and mild thrombocytopenia (n=435) groups.
finding: Mild thrombocytopenia was associated with higher preoperative and postoperative hemoglobin levels and a substantial drop in hemoglobin levels, as well as a higher rate of postoperative complications.
